title: crs's lunchtime preparations
description: a resorucepack about the josh's more foods datapack and the vanilla minecraft bowl
body:
A resourcepack i made in my spare time, completelly redoing almost all of josh's more foods, on top of the vanilla minecraft bowl and all of the stews, since i personally dont like the spritework for it, also includes support for other datapacks:

-josh's more foods

-tasty supplies

-the creeper's code

-survivor's elegy

**all credits go to the creeper's code team, joshmats, siscu and atomic junky
here are their packs:**

[https://modrinth.com/datapack/tasty-supplies](https://modrinth.com/datapack/tasty-supplies)

[https://modrinth.com/datapack/the-creepers-code](https://modrinth.com/datapack/the-creepers-code)

[https://modrinth.com/datapack/joshs-more-foods](https://modrinth.com/datapack/joshs-more-foods)

[https://modrinth.com/datapack/survivors-elegy](https://modrinth.com/datapack/survivors-elegy)

maybe valiance support later when i update it to 1.21.4.
